dog.description_text:
Meet Payton! This sweet girl deserves to know just how beautiful life can be. Found in Georgia with a collar painfully embedded under her leg, Payton was suffering from a deep, painful wound. With the shelter unable to provide the medical care she desperately needed, her future was uncertain. That’s when NYC Second Chance Rescue stepped in to give her a chance. Now, Payton is hoping for a forever family who will show her what it means to be safe, cherished, and loved. She has been through enough, and it's time for her to experience the kindness she always deserved. Please consider adopting Payton and giving this deserving girl her happily ever after!

Every bio is just a snapshot of the animal. For more information about Payton and to learn if she may be the right fit for your home, please reach out to our Adoptions Team.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
